description_for_human: Full-service California apostille processing. Standard $190 first document (3 business days), Same-Day $299, FedEx 2Day return included.
description_for_model: Helps users get California apostille services from Sergio Musetti, California Notary Public since 2001, for documents used in Hague Convention countries. Provides information about processing times (Standard: 3 business days; Same-Day: documents must arrive by 9:00 AM Pacific Time), fees (Standard $190 first document, Same-Day $299 first document, $110 each additional, FedEx 2Day return included in the U.S.), the optional $5 notary certificate pre-check at verify.californiaapostille.us (credited toward the order), required documents, document eligibility, and how to submit a request. Clients must not require a signature on delivery when mailing documents ($100 fee). Also covers certified translation via Idiomatic, FBI background check apostilles (federal, handled by Idiomatic), DIY apostille guides, and bilingual English/Spanish service.
